changelog:
agent-registry v2.0.1

- Migrated all CLI scripts from Python to faster Bun/JavaScript implementations.
- Introduced user prompt hook for agent search (integrated with Claude's plugin system).
- Enhanced install process: optional dependency install for improved UI, Bun-first workflow, Python no longer required.
- Added modern interactive migration UI using @clack/prompts (with fallback to basic text selection).
- Updated docs and commands to reflect new Bun-based CLI; all registry operations via `bun bin/*.js`.
